Show vendors and contracts.
For Lakeshore Holdings, the vendor portfolio spans eight named platforms covering ERP, HCM, treasury, AI, and investment operations.
- Microsoft carries the only high-risk contract in the portfolio and renews in source, making it the most consequential position to examine before that window closes.
- Three renewals fall within the next twelve months — Kyriba (Sep 2026), Ironclad and ServiceNow (both Nov 2026), and Oracle (Dec 2026) — creating a concentrated renegotiation calendar that warrants deliberate sequencing now.
- Annual cost is not confirmed in current business context, which limits the ability to rank these vendors by financial exposure; spend data would sharpen every decision here.
| Vendor | Service | Renewal | Contract Risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kyriba | Treasury workstation and bank connectivity | Sep 2026 | Medium |
| Ironclad | Contract lifecycle management | Nov 2026 | Medium |
| ServiceNow | ITSM and AI governance workflow | Nov 2026 | Medium |
| Oracle | ERP and database services | Dec 2026 | Medium |
| Databricks | AI and analytics workspace | Jan 2027 | Medium |
| Workday | HCM and finance SaaS | Feb 2027 | Medium |
| DealCloud | Portfolio CRM and investment pipeline | Apr 2027 | Low |
| Microsoft | Cloud, identity, productivity, and AI | Jun 2027 | High |
Branch: **Tower** for spend and value prioritization · **Source** to validate Microsoft and near-term renewals as commercial action candidates · **Intelligence** for risk and tradeoff advisory · **Moves** to sequence the 2026 renewal cluster.
